messages.author: 1da6fba54b1166e9
messages.subject: GWAS analysis?
parts:
Dear dartR team,
I would like to know if it is possible to run GWAS using dartR. I tried using dartR to import the SNP data and follow through with the GWAS analysis using GAPIT or rrBLUP but there was always an incompatibility problem. My goal is to run a GWAS report and a Manhattan plot. Since dartR already incorporates much of the data we need for the analysis in ind.metrics and loc.metrics, I would like to know if there are any functions I could use to run the analysis.

Best regards,
Juliana

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: GWAS analysis?
parts:
Hi Juliana,

Please give a try to the below code.

Cheers,
Luis

devtools::install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR.base@dev")
library(dartRverse)
library(GAPIT)
# library(data.table)
g1 <- platypus.gl
# imputing missing data
g1 <- gl.impute(g1)
# testing sex
# removing individuals without sex recorded
sex_tmp <- indNames(g1)[which(g1$other$ind.metrics$Sex=="")]
data_gapit <- gl.drop.ind(g1,ind.list = sex_tmp)
data_gapit <- gl.filter.monomorphs(data_gapit)
#assigning chromosome
data_gapit$chromosome <- data_gapit$other$loc.metrics$Chrom_Platypus_Chrom_NCBIv1
# renaming chromosomes using numbers
data_gapit$chromosome <- as.factor(as.numeric(data_gapit$chromosome))
# assigning SNP position
data_gapit$position <- data_gapit$other$loc.metrics$ChromPos_Platypus_Chrom_NCBIv1
# keeping only snps mapped to the reference genome
locKeep <- locNames(data_gapit)[which(data_gapit$position != 0)]
data_gapit <- gl.keep.loc(data_gapit,loc.list = locKeep)
# converting traits to numeric
class(data_gapit$other$ind.metrics$Sex)
# [1] "factor"
data_gapit$other$ind.metrics$Sex <- as.numeric(data_gapit$other$ind.metrics$Sex)

######################################################################
pheno_gapit_OP <- data_gapit$other$ind.metrics[,c("Sex")]
pheno_gapit_OP <- cbind(indNames(data_gapit),pheno_gapit_OP)
colnames(pheno_gapit_OP) <- c("Taxa",colnames(pheno_gapit_OP)[-1])
pheno_gapit_OP <- as.data.frame(pheno_gapit_OP)
pheno_gapit_OP$pheno_gapit_OP <- as.numeric(pheno_gapit_OP$pheno_gapit_OP)
#converting to GAPIT format
geno_gapit_OP <- gl2gapit(x=data_gapit)
geno <- as.data.frame(geno_gapit_OP)
# Running GAPIT
myGAPIT <- GAPIT(
  # phenotype
  Y= pheno_gapit_OP,
  # HAPMAP format
  G= geno,
  PCA.total = 6,
  model ="Blink"
)

tableg <- myGAPIT$GWAS
tableg2 <- tableg[order(tableg$P.value,decreasing = F),]
tableg2

Hi Juliana,

Based on the data you sent me; I think the problem is that you forgot to update the SNP position using your own dataset.

Check code below.

Cheers,

library(dartRverse)
library(GAPIT)
